get.description: Return a list of all Photo Albums (Image Categories) in a specified project.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier of the photo album (image category). Pass as the {id} path parameter to GET/PATCH/DELETE /rest/v1.0/image_categories/{id}.

count.description: Number of images in the album visible to the requesting user; private images are excluded unless the user has private-photo access.

cover_photo.description: URL of the album's cover thumbnail. Null when the album has no cover image visible to the user.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the album was created, in ISO 8601 format.

show.description: Web URL to view the album's images.

delete.description: REST URL to delete the album via DELETE. Present only when the user may delete the album and it is not the default 'Unclassified' album.

update.description: REST URL to update the album via PATCH. Present only when the user may modify the album and it is not the default 'Unclassified' album.

name.description: Display name of the album, e.g. 'Site Progress - March'.

private.description: Whether the album and its images are restricted to users with private-photo access.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the album was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

position.description: Sort order of the album within the project's album list; lower values appear first.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
